tool_args.title: Statement of Work & Proposal: NextGen Patient Portal & Analytics Dashboard
tool_args.content:
# Statement of Work: NextGen Patient Portal & Analytics Dashboard

**Prepared For:** Lumina Health (Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@lumina-health.io>)
**Prepared By:** Anima (Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer)
**Date:** August 29, 2026
**Project Budget:** $12,500
**Estimated Timeline:** 6 Weeks

## 1. Project Overview
Lumina Health requires a lead full-stack AI engineer to build a state-of-the-art NextGen Patient Portal featuring integrated AI-driven analytics dashboards for secure patient health tracking, predictive insights, and streamlined provider workflows.

## 2. Scope of Work & Deliverables
- **Week 1-2: Architecture & Backend Setup**
  - Establish secure HIPAA-compliant cloud architecture.
  - Develop core database schemas and API endpoints for patient records.
  - Integrate preliminary AI classification and analytics data pipelines.
- **Week 3-4: AI Analytics Dashboard & Frontend Development**
  - Build responsive, accessible React/TypeScript patient and provider portals.
  - Implement real-time data visualization charts and predictive analytics modules.
- **Week 5: Testing, Security Audits & Refinement**
  - Conduct rigorous end-to-end testing, security penetration testing, and performance optimization.
- **Week 6: Deployment & Handover**
  - Deploy production application to client cloud environment.
  - Provide comprehensive technical documentation and system handover training.

## 3. Timeline & Milestones
- Milestone 1 (Week 2): Backend Core & API Architecture
- Milestone 2 (Week 4): Functional UI & AI Analytics Dashboard
- Milestone 3 (Week 6): Production Release & Final Handover

## 4. Payment Terms
- Total Budget: $12,500 USD
- 30% Deposit upon SOW signing
- 40% upon Milestone 2 approval
- 30% upon final production deployment

Looking forward to speaking with you soon!

Anima
